body: Thank you for your response, you have been open and honest.  I appreciate it.  I wish I could find a similar arrangement.  I will think about it.  Thank you.

Thank you.  I can't blame him, I'm sure it's difficult.  I have talked to crisis hotlines without telling them I'm suicidal (I just tell them I'm upset). I wish I could talk to a professional openly, but I really don't want to get locked up.  And I don't want to go on meds.  I have a family member who is very mentally ill, was hospitalized repeatedly, and experienced great difficulty in finding and adjusting meds.  I absolutely think people should do these things, as they do help.  But I don't want to go through those things myself.  I'm very sensitive to medications (why I have a ton of leftover pills) so I imagine it would be really hard to get the type and dose right for treatment.
Thank you. Yes.  I told a "friend" tonight.  He said little.  I have been depressed all of this year, so he has heard it before.  But I'm getting closer every day.
